detail.title: Rotatable two-degree-of-freedom electromagnetic drive passive flexible micro clamp
detail.abstract: The invention discloses a rotatable two-degree-of-freedom electromagnetic drive passive compliant micro clamp, which comprises a clamp fixed end, a clamp rotating end, an electromagnetic device, a linear driver, a magnetic conductive substance and a clamp jaw, wherein the clamp jaw is connected with the clamp rotating end, and two ends of the linear driver are respectively connected with the clamp rotating end and the clamp fixed end through a revolute pair; the linear driver drives the clamp rotating end to realize the rotational freedom of the jaw; the magnetic substance is arranged in the effective adsorption distance of the electromagnetic device, and the electromagnetic device enables the rotating end of the clamp to drive the jaw to realize the clamping freedom degree through adsorbing the magnetic substance. The invention solves the problems that the existing micro clamp has no rotational freedom degree, high realization cost and possible workpiece damage caused by overlarge clamping force.
